content.text:
Manual memory injection now blocks the turn for Claude and Codex instead of only showing a warning banner.

The change is wired through [`lifecycle.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/lifecycle.go), which now prefers a new shared `HookBlockingWriter` capability from [`agent.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/agent.go) and [`capabilities.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/capabilities.go). Claude and Codex implement that in [`claudecode/lifecycle.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/lifecycle.go) and [`codex/lifecycle.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/lifecycle.go) by emitting JSON with `continue: false` and `stopReason`. Gemini still keeps the old non-blocking banner behavior because this branch does not document a blocking protocol for it.

I added regression coverage in [`lifecycle_test.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/lifecycle_test.go), [`claudecode/lifecycle_test.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/lifecycle_test.go), [`codex/lifecycle_test.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/lifecycle_test.go), and [`capabilities_test.go`](/Users/alisha/.superset/worktrees/cli/agent-improvements/cmd/entire/cli/agent/capabilities_test.go).
